integrity: Complete exact arithmetic and standard-library verification code included. All 60 normalized evaluation codes, 1770 pair comparisons, every maximum clique, and all 120 coordinate permutations checked. No external independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for ten-petal Reed--Solomon families of dimension three and length five over F_7 with the common constant-vector center; equivalence is ambient monomial (hence coordinate-permutation). No claims for other parameters or arbitrary linear-equivalence groups. The earlier exact numeric optimum and the number of 138 maximizers are reproduced, not claimed as new.
title: Five monomial-equivalence classes of optimal \((5,3,7;1)\) Reed--Solomon sunflowers
